story_plan.send_reason: Tonight, let me actually look at you when I say it.

slides.wardrobe: Aachu in loose white cotton button-front sleep shirt derived from together-16 white shirt, sleeves rolled to expose right evil-eye bracelet; Zuv in charcoal soft short-sleeve shirt derived from together-18, slim silver chain and small round evil-eye locket at open collar. slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two recognizable adults, Aachu image right and Zuv image left on one bed. Lamp stays on through slide 6. No phones, chores, tears, argument or exaggerated seductive pose.
